speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Venous Stasis Ulcer.

The clinical picture of a chronic non-healing wound on the right lower leg, combined with a history of DVT, chronic swelling, and confirmed venous reflux/obstruction on Doppler, is diagnostic of a venous stasis ulcer. The denial of fever, diabetes, and recent trauma further supports this etiology over infection or arterial causes.
